# FlipHTML5
> FlipHTML5 is an online flipbook maker and digital publishing platform for converting PDFs, Office files, and images into interactive HTML5 publications.

FlipHTML5 helps businesses, educators, marketers, and publishers create, customize, host, share, and monetize digital magazines, catalogs, brochures, ebooks, and other interactive documents. The platform combines document conversion, multimedia interactivity, AI-assisted creation, analytics, branding, and distribution tools.

## Platform Overview
- [Home](https://fliphtml5.com/): Main platform overview for creating and publishing interactive online flipbooks.
- [Features](https://fliphtml5.com/features/): Central feature hub covering conversion, design, sharing, security, and analytics tools.
- [Flipbook Maker App](https://fliphtml5.com/app): Mobile app for creating, managing, and reading flipbooks on mobile devices.

## Creation & Conversion
- [Convert](https://fliphtml5.com/features/convert/): Convert PDF, PPT, Word, and images into HTML5 flipbooks online.
- [Templates](https://fliphtml5.com/features/templates/): Ready-made templates for designing magazines, catalogs, brochures, and other publications.
- [AI Assistant](https://fliphtml5.com/features/ai/): AI-powered content creation for ebooks, copy, and visual publishing workflows.
- [Excel to Catalog](https://fliphtml5.com/features/catalog/): Turn Excel or CSV product data into interactive digital catalogs.
- [Add Links](https://fliphtml5.com/features/add-links/): Add clickable links to publications for navigation, promotion, and conversion paths.

## Interactivity & Reading Experience
- [Interactivity](https://fliphtml5.com/features/interactivity/): Add videos, audio, animations, hotspots, and interactive elements to flipbooks.
- [PDF Chatbot](https://fliphtml5.com/features/chat-with-pdf/): AI chatbot for answering questions from PDFs, catalogs, brochures, and documents.
- [Offline Reading](https://fliphtml5.com/features/share?id=offline_reading): Enable offline access for readers to view publications without an internet connection.
- [Embed](https://fliphtml5.com/features/embed/): Embed flipbooks into websites, blogs, and landing pages with responsive viewers.

## Publishing, Sharing & Distribution
- [Online Sharing](https://fliphtml5.com/features/share/): Share flipbooks through links, QR codes, social channels, and email.
- [Minisite](https://fliphtml5.com/features/minisite/): Build branded minisites to organize and present multiple publications together.
- [Custom Domain](https://fliphtml5.com/features/custom-domain/): Publish flipbooks on a custom domain for branded distribution.
- [SEO Friendly](https://fliphtml5.com/features/seo/): Improve discoverability of flipbooks with search-engine-friendly publishing features.

## Branding, Hosting & Security
- [Branding & Self-hosting](https://fliphtml5.com/features/branding/): Customize branding and deploy publications with self-hosting or white-label options.
- [Security](https://fliphtml5.com/features/security/): Protect publications with privacy controls, access restrictions, and content security settings.

## Commerce & Analytics
- [Digital Sales](https://fliphtml5.com/features/digital-sales/): Sell digital publications and products through integrated monetization features.
- [Statistics](https://fliphtml5.com/features/statistics/): Track publication performance with reader analytics and engagement metrics.

## Related AI Tool
- [Create Video & Photo with AI](https://mangoanimate.com/ai?utm_source=fh5-frontpage&utm_medium=features&utm_campaign=mangoai): Related AI media creation tool linked from FlipHTML5 feature navigation.
